title.suggested: Allen Billed for Athletic Tournament in Belleville

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen, "the ex-champion of the world," was expected at a grand athletic tournament at the old Turner hall in Belleville the following Friday, with Tom Kelly and John Brooks.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Republican: St. Louis, Sunday Morning, February 25, 1883', page 2.

facts.fact: Allen was announced to appear at a grand athletic tournament at the old Turner hall in Belleville, Illinois, with Prof. John Brooks and Tom Kelly

notes: Event date is 'next Friday' after Sunday Feb 25, 1883, i.e. March 2; the paper says attendance 'it is claimed', so it was only announced.
